description: This file defines the Stream class which implements PSR-7 StreamInterface for handling and manipulating stream resources in a web application context, including reading, writing, seeking, and metadata management.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Implementation of PSR-7 StreamInterface, managing PHP stream resources with capabilities for reading, writing, seeking, and metadata handling, including support for caching stream contents.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream object with a PHP resource and optional cache stream, verifying resource validity and cache properties.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the underlying stream resource, either all data or specific key-value pair.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying PHP resource from the stream object, resetting internal properties and returning the old resource.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire contents of the stream as a string, rewinding if seekable and considering cache.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream resource, handling pipes differently, and detaches the resource.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if determinable via fstat, considering pipe streams.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the pointer within the stream, throws if cannot determine.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Determines if the stream is readable based on mode or if it's a pipe.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Determines if the stream is writable based on mode.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the pointer within the stream to a specified offset.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream pointer to the beginning.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads specified length of data from the stream, updating cache if present.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, updating size cache.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads remaining contents from the stream, updating cache if applicable.

methods.name: isPipe
methods.description: Checks if the stream resource is a pipe.
